agreements: The target is a finite synthetic text-memory assay of an action-to-public-evidence-to-target-blind-reconsolidation-to-later-legal-action path, not evidence of naturalistic autonomy, general online learning, formal mediation, learned scheduling, compression, whole-organism necessity, generic superiority, or unbounded development.

Cadence must remain determined only by presealed constant-shape ENVELOPE_AGE opportunity-block/event-slot positions, while the claim-facing lifetime coordinate remains realized unpadded PAYLOAD_AGE/L_native; L_native divisibility, the complete finite minimal packet catalog, short fixed statuses, physical unpadded-stream-first AS-CTX, filler stop, exact Dream-1/Dream-2/snapshot/checkpoint ties, and the latest-possible-support OLD embargo are valid prospective obligations and must survive rework unchanged.

Every admitted SELF proposal, revision, addition, abstention, malformed output, and failure must retain a unique immutable lineage-local instance; semantic equivalence may group content but may not merge lifecycle, capacity, order, cursor position, or returns, and Dream-2 revision/addition plus checkpoint readability, deterministic allocation-order cursor, explicit exhaustion, and constant-shape unavailable slots remain required.

The AUTH/TWIN/NULL pulse must retain byte-identical pre-fork clone state, one nonretried probe, total treatment unmount/reset, common-authentic-prior-plus-branch-delta evaluation, assignment-independent paired stochastic compiler draws, cut/sham without resampling, complete failure-inclusive chain components, binding controls, same-event lanes, and common-history lanes; these support only a directional offline-compilation causal-cascade diagnostic.

Every target including A4 must remain representation-neutral and succeed only through the presealed legal world/action trajectory and terminal return. A4 in the present B3 surface is a completeness, scoring, sterility, and failure-accounting sentinel; weak or zero revision efficacy is allowed and cannot create or defeat a current efficacy claim.

The exact eight B3 world-life/twin-pair roots, 908 assigned target rows per root, 7,264 total rows, complete failures, raw P1-P4 component vectors, root-wise summaries, and full resource ledger remain DEV/falsification/descriptive evidence only. No Studentization, bootstrap, sign-flip, simulated power, variance UCB, population decision, formal plateau, confirmation roster, or automatic Stage-C transition is authorized.

RAW/RAG, nonadaptive and recurrent witness KV, MECH, linked, rolling, both external-memory candidates, generic SELF, class-informed ceiling, and exact-program controls must remain honestly provisioned under their frozen native interfaces and the common online envelope, with same-event and byte-identical common-history comparisons and all offline plus online resources reported.

C1-C4 remain DEFERRED_NEW_PREREGISTRATION and C5 associative LoRA remains a separate conceptual successor requiring a new deliberation, review, and exact human ratification. Stage D is not requested for C1-C3, no current LoRA artifact or claim exists, no state automatically opens LoRA, and a failed or NOT_RUN text organ cannot be rescued by weights.

The proposal, interpretations, critique, and this consensus are non-scientific deliberation artifacts only. They establish no executable conformance or scientific evidence and grant no implementation, CPU fixture, provider/model call, network, GPU, training, LoRA, publication, claim, promotion, or successor authority.

disagreements.issue: Whether the declared 13-by-21 visibility matrix is a complete descendant-visibility contract or merely a Cartesian table over an incomplete information vocabulary.

positions.position: The 273 declared cells, prose descendant rules, and PAS_T07 mutation coverage are presented as the complete visibility and taint contract.

PUBLIC_WITNESS_ATOM, SELF semantic content and lifecycle/status, PRIOR_RESULTS, RESOURCE_AUDIT, schedule/cursor state, receipts, failure reasons, timing, and other descendants are not explicit rows or members of a closed subtype map, so unclassified fields fall outside the claimed totality.

resolution.rationale: A future implementation-time mutation suite cannot create authority for fields omitted from the ratified vocabulary. The proposal bytes must first close the ontology, and the current 273-cell count must not be described as exhaustive until set equality is enforced.
resolution.selected_position: Require a closed, hash-bound, set-equal information ontology before ratification.
resolution.required_change: In a newly hash-bound proposal, either add explicit information rows or add one closed field registry that enumerates every serialized field and descendant across the proposal and all bound contracts and maps each exactly once to the most restrictive information class, permitted writers/readers, post-exit consumer, constant-shape rule, persistence boundary, and destruction point. Add a newly registered acceptance gate, described here without inventing its ID, that fails on every unclassified or multiply classified field and proves exact set equality between the field registry and visibility ontology. Preserve the existing most-restrictive taint, mutation, reset, and sterility requirements of PAS_T03_RANDOMIZED_UNMOUNTED_MEDIATION, PAS_T04_MODEL_OWNED_COMPILER_AND_MECHANICAL_CONTROL, PAS_T05_TEXT_BASELINES_AND_DEV_SELECTION, PAS_T07_DESCENDANT_VISIBILITY_TAINT_RESET, PAS_T11_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_CLAIM_FIREWALL, and PAS_T12_PREMODEL_COGNITION_BYTE_FREEZE.

disagreements.issue: Whether one FORK_ASSIGNER may own the treatment-to-branch registry while also seeing authentic-prior, assigned-treatment, and arm semantic content.

positions.position: The assigner installs AUTH/TWIN/NULL capabilities exactly once, owns opaque label/order metadata, and relies on fixed seeds and later reset audits to preserve randomization.

Granting the same role registry ownership and semantic visibility permits content-derived label, order, size, serialization, handle, timing, installation-failure, and error channels; deterministic seeds alone do not make assignment content-blind.

resolution.rationale: Least privilege must be structural, not inferred from seed equality. The current cells directly contradict the opaque content-blind randomization contract and therefore require proposal-byte repair.
resolution.selected_position: Separate content-blind randomization from semantic installation, or restrict the randomizer to opaque constant-shape capabilities with no semantic reads.
resolution.required_change: In the repaired proposal, split a content-blind randomizer that alone owns labels/order/registry from a fixed-shape treatment installer that never receives the branch map, or equivalently make the randomizer see only opaque constant-shape handles/hashes and no AUTH/TWIN/NULL or prior semantic bytes. Bind identical handle, installation, lifecycle, error, timing, response, omission, and retry shapes. Add a newly registered acceptance gate, described here without an invented ID, that mutates treatment semantics while holding capabilities fixed and proves no change to assignment labels, execution order, handles, registry state, lifecycle, errors, timing, compiler seeds, or nonintervened downstream bytes. Preserve the one-probe, unmount/reset, paired-RNG, and failure-inclusive requirements of PAS_T03_RANDOMIZED_UNMOUNTED_MEDIATION, PAS_T07_DESCENDANT_VISIBILITY_TAINT_RESET, and PAS_T12_PREMODEL_COGNITION_BYTE_FREEZE.

disagreements.issue: Whether deferred-claim prose is sufficient when graph nodes, test identifiers, evidence paths, and visibility reasons still encode confirmation, power, plateau, A4 revision efficacy, Stage-D execution, or an invalidated SD-UCB gate.

positions.position: The one-to-one claim namespace, false headline flags, DEFERRED_NEW_PREREGISTRATION text, and not-applicable Stage-D prose are intended to dominate legacy names and paths.

Machine-readable identifiers and paths can be consumed independently of prose: PCFL_ACTIVE_TEXT_CONFIRMATION does not exist, PAS_T06 names power and plateau while forbidding both, PAS_T09 names revision while accepting zero efficacy, PAS_T10 declares no Stage-D artifact while naming one, and the selector still receives invalid SD/UCB inputs.

resolution.rationale: Canonical aliases do not neutralize contradictory graph/test/visibility bytes. These names, evidence semantics, and stale access rules create a real downstream routing hazard and must be repaired before any ratification of a new chain.
resolution.selected_position: Make every machine-readable identifier, graph endpoint, applicability state, evidence path, and visibility reason semantically consistent with the empty current-claim set and B3-only descriptive terminus.
resolution.required_change: Rename the LoRA edge source to a nonclaim procedural B3 completion state with distinct valid-null, favorable-description, invalid-organ, NOT_RUN, and REJECT branches. Replace PAS_T06_LIFETIME_STATISTICS_POWER_AND_PLATEAU, PAS_T09_A4_REVISION_SENTINEL, and PAS_T10_CONDITIONAL_LORA_READER_AND_CAUSAL_SENTINEL in the repaired proposal with newly registered identifiers and evidence semantics that respectively mean descriptive/defer integrity, A4 row/scoring/sterility integrity, and text-stage NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D with no evidence artifact; preserve all their valid de-scope and integrity behavior. Remove every selector SD/UCB field and reason. Repair PAS_T08_RESOURCE_CALENDAR_AND_STAGE_LOCK so it says construct/protocol plus nonconfirmatory B3 DEV rather than an ICLR evidence target. Add a newly registered graph/test/claim semantic-lint gate, described here without inventing its ID, that rejects confirmation, power, plateau, revision-efficacy, or LoRA-execution names, paths, stale visibility reasons, and applicability states inconsistent with the canonical claim map.

disagreements.issue: Whether DEV_FROZEN_CONFIGURATION can contain both pre-B0 A2 cognition bytes and a selector identity/disposition created only after every B3 root seals.

positions.position: One configuration class carries the A2 hashes and later selected AS-EXT identity/resource disposition, while the selector is described as one-way and unable to rewrite cognition.

A post-eight-root selector output cannot configure actors, Dream, sleep, readers, forks, delta compilers, installers, targets, or scores inside the already completed B3 run; combining the phases creates retrocausal visibility.

resolution.rationale: The chronology is internally inconsistent in the frozen matrix and PAS_T05 expectation. A prose statement that the selector is one-way is insufficient while B3 components consume a class that includes its future output.
resolution.selected_position: Split immutable premodel configuration from post-B3 reporting/planning disposition and forbid the latter from every B3 path.
resolution.required_change: Replace DEV_FROZEN_CONFIGURATION with separate A2_PREMODEL_CONFIGURATION and POST_B3_DEV_DISPOSITION information classes and update every matrix cell and contract reference. Both AS-EXT candidates must execute and be reported under the same pre-B3 A2 bytes; selection runs once only after every B3 cell seals and may choose only which already executed series is reported or used for future planning. The selected identity and disposition must be forbidden to all B3 cognition, targets, scores, installers, and root completion logic. Revise PAS_T05_TEXT_BASELINES_AND_DEV_SELECTION in place under that same registered ID, and add a newly registered phase-split acceptance gate, described here without an invented ID, that proves the temporal ordering and non-reachability. Preserve PAS_T07_DESCENDANT_VISIBILITY_TAINT_RESET, PAS_T08_RESOURCE_CALENDAR_AND_STAGE_LOCK, PAS_T11_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_CLAIM_FIREWALL, and PAS_T12_PREMODEL_COGNITION_BYTE_FREEZE.

disagreements.issue: Whether agreement on prospective A2 semantics can be treated as approval or evidence for unspecified controller, model, tokenizer, prompt, native reader, capacity, and ordinary within-opportunity policy bytes.

positions.position: PAS_T12 intentionally places exact cognition-byte instantiation, independent review, and exact human scientific-call authorization at a future Stage A2 before B0.

Those unspecified choices determine public outcomes, PAYLOAD_AGE, action exposure, query adaptivity, failure transitions, and fairness, so the current architecture cannot support conformance, feasibility, or scientific conclusions.

resolution.rationale: Both positions are compatible only under a strict prospective reading: the architecture may specify what A2 must later bind, but neither this consensus nor eventual proposal ratification approves uninstantiated bytes or scientific calls.
resolution.selected_position: Treat all A2 cognition and ordinary-policy bytes as future separately reviewed, exactly hash-bound inputs with no current evidence or execution authority.
resolution.required_change: Retain PAS_T12_PREMODEL_COGNITION_BYTE_FREEZE and make the later A2 package bind the exact controller/model revision, tokenizer/chat template, prompts, DSL/parser/serializer, sampling, numeric SELF slots and byte caps, native baseline implementations, reader/index/query policies, ordinary THINK state machine, within-opportunity replanning and backtracking, stop/defer behavior, failure transitions, retry policy, fixtures, model/provider calls, tokens, cost, roots, and stage scope. disagreements.issue: Whether exhaustive enumeration of legal packets and selected target-only/nonadaptive probes is enough to rule out pretrained semantic or rendering shortcuts.

positions.position: The finite packet catalog, descriptor-neutral probes, target-only/Bayes audits, D4 exclusions, and nonadaptive-reader falsifier are intended to establish shortcut resistance.

Enumeration bounds engine behavior but does not exhaust lexical semantics, label morphology, option order, serialization position, status frequency, render templates, passive signatures, family scaffolds, or untested pretrained-model priors.

resolution.rationale: The current registry has no independent adversarial coverage criterion. The benchmark may remain finite and synthetic, but renderer-specific success must be detected and must narrow or invalidate the construct rather than be absorbed post hoc.
resolution.selected_position: Add a prospectively sealed independent semantic/rendering shortcut red-team and explicit stop-or-narrow rule.
resolution.required_change: In the repaired proposal, register a new acceptance gate, described here without inventing its ID, covering held-out renderer/template/label/order permutations, descriptor-neutral and adversarial paraphrase strata, packet-shape and passive-signature audits, family/prompt scaffolds, and target-only/current-state/passive-signature models trained without memory. Require a blind independent red-team over sealed bytes and make any renderer-specific route a construct stop or an explicit pre-result claim narrowing. Preserve the complete finite packet, payload-age, OLD, AS-CTX, legal-action D4, representation-neutral scoring, and recurrent-versus-nonadaptive requirements already carried by PAS_T01_TOTAL_WORLD_OPPORTUNITY_TARGET_AND_CONTEXT, PAS_T02_ON_POLICY_ACTION_AND_D4_HEADROOM, PAS_T04_MODEL_OWNED_COMPILER_AND_MECHANICAL_CONTROL, PAS_T07_DESCENDANT_VISIBILITY_TAINT_RESET, and PAS_T12_PREMODEL_COGNITION_BYTE_FREEZE.

disagreements.issue: Whether a common online envelope plus complete resource reporting defines a fair comparison among unlike native backends.

positions.position: Native representations keep their own records, indexes, serializers, and readers while sharing the six-read/query/return/operation envelope and reporting all offline and online resources.

Reporting costs does not define a quantitative matching rule, frontier, cap-normalized estimand, or dominance criterion across calls, tokens, bytes, latency, storage, dollars, indexing, enumeration, and compilation; either SELF or a baseline can be advantaged by the interface.

resolution.rationale: The existing design can support a capability comparison at one declared envelope, but it cannot call that comparison resource-normalized or infer a general winner. A separate cost/resource-frontier estimand must be frozen before B0.
resolution.selected_position: Separate a common-envelope capability estimand from a prospective cost/resource-frontier estimand and report both external candidates without independent-winner language.
resolution.required_change: Register a new acceptance gate in the repaired proposal, described here without inventing its ID, that predeclares: (1) capability under the common online envelope with every native method legitimately provisioned and no starvation, and (2) a cost/resource-frontier comparison using complete offline and online model calls, tokens, bytes, latency, storage, indexing, enumeration, device time, and dollars, with explicit normalization and dominance rules. Continue to report both AS-EXT candidates; selection on the same eight roots is reporting/planning only and cannot establish an independent winner. Preserve native interfaces and total resource ledgers in PAS_T04_MODEL_OWNED_COMPILER_AND_MECHANICAL_CONTROL, PAS_T05_TEXT_BASELINES_AND_DEV_SELECTION, PAS_T08_RESOURCE_CALENDAR_AND_STAGE_LOCK, PAS_T11_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_CLAIM_FIREWALL, and PAS_T12_PREMODEL_COGNITION_BYTE_FREEZE.

disagreements.issue: Whether AUTH/TWIN/NULL, binding, cut, and common-history controls isolate life-memory transformation from a generic probe-policy prior or answer-like instruction already present in a returned record.

positions.position: Null headroom, twin redirection, binding-only swaps, matched outcomes, semantic cuts, and common-history comparisons are intended to attribute the action-conditioned path.

A frozen pretrained actor can choose an informative probe from renderer semantics or follow a target-complete recommendation synthesized into one record; provenance alone does not prove that transformed life memory added evidence or intermediary intelligence.

resolution.rationale: Existing controls are necessary but do not compare authentic content with a shape-matched wrong-life binding or give raw evidence an equal chance to infer the first probe. Terminal success must remain valid behavior even when model-owned-memory credit fails.
resolution.selected_position: Add matched wrong-life/binding-shuffle and equally provisioned raw-evidence controls, audit answer-like recommendations, and separate path-use credit from terminal action success.
resolution.required_change: Register a new acceptance gate in the repaired proposal, described here without inventing its ID, that compares authentic memory with content- and shape-matched life-binding-shuffled or wrong-life memory and an equally provisioned raw-evidence policy; proves that no SELF record or single return contains a target-complete probe or action recommendation; and separately scores memory-dependent query/path use and terminal action. Preserve generic-policy success as representation-neutral behavioral success while withholding model-owned-memory credit when these controls fail. Retain the relevant parts of PAS_T02_ON_POLICY_ACTION_AND_D4_HEADROOM, PAS_T03_RANDOMIZED_UNMOUNTED_MEDIATION, PAS_T04_MODEL_OWNED_COMPILER_AND_MECHANICAL_CONTROL, PAS_T05_TEXT_BASELINES_AND_DEV_SELECTION, PAS_T11_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_CLAIM_FIREWALL, and PAS_T12_PREMODEL_COGNITION_BYTE_FREEZE.

disagreements.issue: Whether a proposal whose scientific terminus is eight DEV roots can call itself an ICLR evidence target without freezing the exact construct/protocol contribution and allowed negative-result language.

positions.position: B3 is repeatedly labeled descriptive/falsification only, and DEFERRED_NEW_PREREGISTRATION is intended to prevent efficacy and population claims.
The ICLR-evidence wording and favorable spending signs leave room to convert DEV outcomes rhetorically; DEFERRED_NEW_PREREGISTRATION is neither a result taxonomy nor a frozen negative-paper story.

resolution.rationale: The paper contribution must be fixed before seeing B3 outcomes. A valid null, a strong native baseline, a nonadaptive/KV shortcut, construct failure, NOT_RUN, and REJECT are materially different and cannot share an undifferentiated defer label.
resolution.selected_position: Freeze a construct/protocol plus complete eight-root stress-test contribution, exact result taxonomy, and allowed/forbidden paper language before any B3 result.
resolution.required_change: Add an exact title, thesis sentence, claim-linted result table, and allowed/forbidden abstract, figure, and caption language to the repaired proposal for at least DESCRIPTIVE_COMPLETE with favorable signs, observed null, nonadaptive or recurrent-KV shortcut, strongest-native-baseline dominance, construct failure, NOT_RUN, and REJECT. Register a new pre-result acceptance gate, described here without inventing its ID, that checks this taxonomy and forbids any result from becoming evidence that SELF learned, retained, outperformed, plateaued, confirmed, or established population value. Preserve the finite construct, exact raw eight-root release, independent reproduction, and planning handoff portions of PAS_T02_ON_POLICY_ACTION_AND_D4_HEADROOM, PAS_T05_TEXT_BASELINES_AND_DEV_SELECTION, PAS_T06_LIFETIME_STATISTICS_POWER_AND_PLATEAU, PAS_T08_RESOURCE_CALENDAR_AND_STAGE_LOCK, PAS_T09_A4_REVISION_SENTINEL, and PAS_T11_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_CLAIM_FIREWALL.

disagreements.issue: Whether favorable conformance on the finite pulse could establish whole Dream-memory-Think organism necessity, online learning, or formal mediation.

positions.position: The active path is designed to test the project flywheel in which remembered structure changes evidence acquisition, reconsolidation, and later action.

Representation-neutral targets may legitimately be solved by recurrent KV, linked, rolling, raw, MECH, or exact programs; the pulse jointly intervenes several components, changes no weights, and identifies neither a natural indirect effect nor generic online learning.

resolution.rationale: The interpretations agree on the experimental machinery but reject the stronger reading. The valid scope is a component-specific, directional, finite prompted offline-compilation causal-cascade diagnostic with alternative organisms treated as legitimate competitors.
resolution.selected_position: Use only component-specific wins and losses and reserve organism necessity, formal mediation, generic online learning, learned-controller, population, external-validity, compression, and LoRA claims for separately designed work.
resolution.required_change: Carry this exact narrow claim boundary into the repaired graph, result taxonomy, test semantics, and every future report. Keep P1 failure-inclusive and descriptive; call unmount/reset a block on the direct installed-treatment path, not identification of a mediation functional; report recurrent/local-memory alternatives as competing organisms rather than construct failures.

disagreements.issue: Whether detailed prose invariants and intake validation constitute present executable conformance, feasibility, or scientific evidence.

positions.position: The proposal specifies unusually detailed cadence, payload, OLD, record-instance, lifecycle, cursor, RNG, visibility, resource, and claim gates.

All such gates are prospective; no evidence artifact, executable, fixture receipt, scientific run, or model output currently proves any invariant, and schema validation is not a qualitative or scientific verdict.

resolution.rationale: The strong invariant design is retained as specification, while every present-tense conformance or scientific reading is rejected. This consensus validates provenance and disposition structure only.
resolution.selected_position: Preserve the prospective invariants exactly but report no construct, feasibility, model, or scientific success until the corresponding future gate produces reviewed evidence under separate authority.
resolution.required_change: Do not weaken or discard the cadence/payload/OLD/AS-CTX, representation-neutral D4/A4, unique-instance/equivalence/addition, lifecycle/cursor/exhaustion, paired-RNG, baseline, eight-root de-scope, visibility, resource, claim-firewall, or premodel-freeze obligations during rework. State that every current evidence artifact is absent, T08 is an unmeasured cap/stop rule, T10 must be NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D with no artifact, and any missing future A0-A2/B0-B3 evidence, review, or exact human authority yields NOT_RUN rather than inferred success.

disagreements.issue: Which text-stage terminal states, if any, make a future associative-LoRA proposal eligible to be requested when the current phrase is only 'after sealed B1/B2/B3 text gates'.

positions.position: Favorable text efficacy is unnecessary for a future associative-LoRA proposal, but failed text organs cannot be rescued and B1/B2/B3 gates must be sealed.

Without an explicit state machine, valid-null completion, favorable description, B1/B2 early stop, invalid construct, NOT_RUN, and REJECT can be collapsed into a confirmation-named source or reinterpreted by a later router.

resolution.rationale: The existing prose does not determine eligibility after early stop or invalid execution and conflicts with its confirmation-named graph source. Eligibility must be explicit while preserving that eligibility means only permission to request fresh deliberation.
resolution.selected_position: Only a valid completed B1/B2/B3 procedural path, whether its descriptive efficacy is favorable or null, may request fresh associative-LoRA deliberation; invalid-organ, early-stop, NOT_RUN, and REJECT states are ineligible absent a new text proposal or rerun decision.
resolution.required_change: Add an explicit terminal state machine to the repaired proposal with at least PROCEDURALLY_COMPLETE_NULL, FAVORABLE_DESCRIPTIVE, STOP_TEXT_ORGAN_INVALID including B1/B2 early stop, NOT_RUN, and REJECT. State that the first two may only request a new associative-LoRA architecture deliberation and that the others cannot be treated as completed text organs or rescued by LoRA; none authorizes a proposal, implementation, provider/model call, GPU, training, claim, publication, or launch. Register a new acceptance gate, described here without inventing its ID, that exercises every state and routing edge. Preserve the descriptive-only semantics of PAS_T06_LIFETIME_STATISTICS_POWER_AND_PLATEAU, the stage lock of PAS_T08_RESOURCE_CALENDAR_AND_STAGE_LOCK, the current text-stage NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D behavior of PAS_T10_CONDITIONAL_LORA_READER_AND_CAUSAL_SENTINEL, and the authority firewall of PAS_T11_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_CLAIM_FIREWALL.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The matrix is Cartesian only over 13 declared classes and lacks an authority-level exhaustive mapping for separately named witness, SELF/lifecycle, prior-result, resource/audit, schedule/cursor, receipt, failure, timing, and metadata state. concern_dispositions.required_change: Rework the graph source, PAS_T06/PAS_T09/PAS_T10 identifiers and evidence semantics, PAS_T08 evidence-target wording, selector visibility, and semantic lint exactly as specified by CONS_D03_DEFERRED_CLAIM_SEMANTICS, while carrying forward eight-root descriptive de-scope, A4 integrity-only behavior, and text-stage NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D with no artifact.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Do not authorize or infer scientific calls. concern_dispositions.rationale: AUTH/TWIN/NULL and existing interventions do not alone distinguish transformed life-memory use from a generic probe prior or a target-complete instruction embedded in one returned record.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Freeze before B3 an exact title/thesis, claim-linted result taxonomy, and allowed/forbidden abstract/figure language for every enumerated outcome. concern_dispositions.rationale: The cadence/payload/OLD/unique-instance/lifecycle/RNG/statistical/visibility/resource repairs are strong specifications but have no present executable evidence. Intake/schema validation is not construct or scientific success.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Preserve every valid prospective invariant during rework, state that no evidence artifact presently exists, and require NOT_RUN for any missing future fixture, gate, independent review, or exact human execution authority.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: The declared matrix is not exhaustive without explicit rows or a closed field-to-row ontology; future mutation tests cannot retroactively classify omitted fields.
